ios.desc:
Join the fun with MapCut, the app that gets you outside and moving! Whether you're tracking your daily walks with HealthKit or completing exciting daily challenges, there's always something to do. With a sprinkle of humour and a dash of adventure, MapCut makes your day a little brighter.

For the Casual Adventurer:
MapCut is designed for casual people, not hardcore fitness buffs. It's about enjoying the journey and discovering new things, not about breaking records. We value trying out new things just for fun, and nothing else.

Daily Challenges:
• Explore New Routes: Receive unique, personalized routes to conquer every day. Complete your challenge while it's active to earn Achievement Points.
• Capture the Moments: Enjoy daily challenges, like being out there for sunset or sunrise and capturing those stunning moments to earn points for your gallery.
• Surprise Adventures: Let our app surprise you with a challenge based on your location and past activities. From fun photo missions to quirky quests, there's always a new way to explore.

Track Your Activities:
• Sync with HealthKit and Apple Watch to log all your activities. See your routes displayed on the map and track your progress over time.

Earn Bragging Rights:
• Achievement Points are up for grabs with every challenge you complete. They're not worth much in the real world, but the bragging rights are priceless!

Share Your Adventures:
• Show off your completed challenges and stunning photos with friends. Who's the ultimate MapCutter in your crew?

Join the MapCut Community:
• Connect with fellow adventurers who, like you, are out there touching some grass and making memories. With dozens (almost) of MapCutters, there's always someone to share your journey with.

Why MapCut?
• Fun, simple, and a great way to get moving.
• Discover new routes and hidden gems in your area.
• Enjoy a daily dose of outdoor adventure.
• Perfect for those who want to spend less time on their phones and more time exploring the world.

Download MapCut today and start your adventure! Adventure is just a step away, and the bragging rights are free!"

quotes.text: Made a simple app to put all my Apple Watch walks on the same map, so I can walk every street in my city. Surprisingly there wasn't anything available that was free or straightforward, despite it being an easy app to develop. Honestly, it's extremely fun to use something of your own every day, and patch it up when you come up with some other ideas. I did release it on AppStore (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mapcut/id6478268682), but mostly for my friends so they can use it as well.
